versions.content: A report of DEM_EVENT_STATUS_FDC_THRESHOLD_REACHED (e.g. either via interface call or when reaching the configured threshold in debounce algorithm) which is considered as consecutive report of a Failed event shall not be stored to the failure memory. The handling shall be analogous to storage condition not fulfilled.
